name: cc-dev-kit
description: Personal Claude Code marketplace: a stack-agnostic dev-workflow (agents + skills, with on-demand stack packs like the Laravel skill) plus meta tooling for authoring agents and skills. Nothing hardcodes a project — agents learn each repo's conventions at runtime.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic dev workflow: architect / feature-builder / senior-developer / code-reviewer agents, plus skills for feature-flow orchestration (with up-front acceptance criteria; can also execute story files prepared by product-workflow), greenfield project bootstrap, test-first TDD, commit / pr git, and a `laravel` stack pack the agents pull in on demand. The agents learn each project's conventions at runtime by reading its CLAUDE.md and sibling files — no hardcoded paths or framework.

plugins.name: product-workflow
plugins.description: Upstream product workflow: shape an idea into a brief (product-brief), turn it into a right-sized feature spec or PRD with epics (product-spec), then cut each epic into self-contained story files plus a flat ordered backlog (create-stories). Elicitation happens in the main conversation; drafting is dispatched to a non-interactive product-manager agent. Stories are written so dev-workflow's feature-flow can execute each one from the story file + CLAUDE.md alone. Inspired by BMAD-METHOD and AIDD.

plugins.name: meta-workflow
plugins.description: Toolkit for authoring and improving Claude Code assets. The retro skill runs an offline retrospective over your past sessions, distilling recurring friction into durable fixes. The memory-maintenance skill triages your existing auto-memory corpus and reconciles the index, never committing. Complements dev-workflow, which targets application code.
